nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a commutative additive monoid with a multiplication, and let $A$, $B$, $C$ be $n \times n$ matrices over $\alpha$, stored as vectors of rows. The matrix returned by square matrix accumulation on $A$, $B$, $C$ equals $C + AB$, where $AB$ is the matrix product, $(AB)_{ij} = \sum_{k < n} A_{ik} B_{kj}$.
nodes.title: Square matrix accumulation computes $C + AB$

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a type with an addition and a multiplication, and let $A$, $B$, $C$ be $n \times n$ matrices over $\alpha$. Square matrix accumulation on $A$, $B$, $C$ has cost $(n^3, n^3)$: it charges exactly $n^3$ scalar multiplications and exactly $n^3$ scalar additions.
nodes.title: Operation count of square matrix accumulation

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a type with an addition and a multiplication, and let $A$, $B$, $C$ be $n \times n$ matrices over $\alpha$, stored as vectors of rows. Square matrix accumulation on $A$, $B$, $C$ is rectangular matrix accumulation on $A$, $B$, $C$ with all three dimensions equal to $n$: it adds $AB$ to the accumulator $C$ and returns the result with its cost pair (scalar multiplications, scalar additions).
nodes.title: Square matrix accumulation

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a commutative additive monoid with a multiplication, and let $A$, $B$, $C$ be $p \times q$, $q \times r$ and $p \times r$ matrices over $\alpha$, stored as vectors of rows. For all $i < p$ and $j < r$, the $(i, j)$ entry of the matrix returned by rectangular matrix accumulation on $A$, $B$, $C$ is $C_{ij} + \sum_{k < q} A_{ik} B_{kj}$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
